description: Directional lookup: does the visit state recognize a carry permit issued by the home state? Returns status (honored / honored_with_conditions / not_honored / no_permit_exists), the honoring state's explanation and official source URL, verification date, and the visit state's permitless-carry status. Not legal advice. Read-only.
